in_marathi.name: Lakshmanan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Fortune, Wealth, Protection
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lakshmanan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Lakshmanan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Lakshmana', which means 'protector of wealth or fortunes'. In Hindu mythology, Lakshmana is the younger brother of Lord Rama and the embodiment of loyalty, devotion, and strength. The name is believed to bring wealth, prosperity, and protection to the bearer.
